Order 
As against the order dated 06.12.2022 passed by the 1 st respondent though this writ petition has been filed, the learned counsel for the petitioner after having noted the provisions under Section 20 of the Tamil Nadu Highways Act, 2001, wanted this writ petition to be withdrawn with liberty to approach the Officer concerned i.e. either Collector or the Authorised Officer to make an application for referring the matter to the concerned Court for determination of an enhanced compensation as sought for by the petitioner.
2. Recording the said submission made by the learned counsel appearing for the petitioner, this Writ Petition is dismissed as withdrawn with aforesaid liberty.

It is made clear that, within two weeks from the date of receipt of a copy of this order, the petitioner shall make an application https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis either to the Collector or the Officer to whom the case was transferred to make an application to refer the matter to the Court concerned for determination of the compensation.
